chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated to us, saying: Al-Qassim ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Hazim narrated to us, saying: 'Ubays ibn Hisham narrated to us, from Abdullah ibn Jubala, from Muhammad ibn Sulayman, from al-Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him) that he said:
As-Sufyani and Al-Qa'im will be in one year.

key_terms.السُّفْيَانِيُّ: As-Sufyani, a specific leader or figure whose emergence is a major sign of the end times in Shia eschatology.
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: Al-Qa'im, referring to Imam Al-Mahdi (peace be upon him), the twelfth Imam who will rise to establish justice.
key_terms.سَنَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ: One year, indicating the same calendar year or a short, indistinguishable period in the context of their appearances.

ai.seo_question: When will the Sufyani and the Mahdi appear according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (AS) establishes a precise chronological link between the rise of the Sufyani, whose military campaigns serve as a primary catalyst for global upheaval, and the emergence of Al-Qa'im. In Shia eschatological tradition, this simultaneity underscores that the Sufyani's appearance is not merely a precursor but an integral component of the Mahdi's immediate advent, signaling the onset of the final era of justice.
